page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.14xlarge is a general-purpose instance type powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 56 dedicated physical cores utilizing the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor, operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 224.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU hardware, and it delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear performance tradeoff between single-core and multi-core execution. Single-core performance is relatively low, with stress-ng single-core CPU and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the weak category, and single-threaded gzip compression registering as poor. Conversely, the 56 dedicated cores enable average multi-core performance across stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth for both small and large blocks, along with Passmark memory scores, consistently registers in the average tier.

Given its hardware profile, the instance is suited for multi-threaded workloads that can leverage its high core count to compensate for modest single-core speeds. Appropriate workloads include software compilation, multi-threaded decompression, static web serving, and database operations, all of which achieved average tier results in benchmarks. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the instance offers high resource density for parallel processing tasks, though workloads dependent on high single-thread performance or local NVMe storage may find the hardware architecture less optimal.
